questions.prompt: Walter Davis and Hedo Türkoğlu ran other finalists' offenses. How many assists per game did Mark Jackson average for the 1997–98 Pacers?
questions.note: 8.7 a game from the pass-first point guard of a Pacers team that took Jordan's Bulls to a seventh game.

funFacts.text: Jackson distributed 713 assists in the regular season.
He started all eighty-two regular-season games.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Mark Jackson | PG | 82 | 82

funFacts.text: Indiana's season ended in a hard-fought seven-game series loss to the Bulls in the East finals.

questions.prompt: What did Joakim Noah average in rebounds in the 2010–11 regular season?
questions.note: 10.4 in 48 games, after surgery on a torn ligament in his right hand.

funFacts.text: Noah underwent surgery for a hand ligament injury and returned late in the season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Joakim Noah underwent surgery on December 16 to repair a torn ligament in his right hand.

funFacts.text: Noah appeared in fewer than 50 regular-season games that year because of injury.
He also earned a place on the NBA All-Defensive Second Team.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Joakim Noah made the NBA All-Defensive Second Team

questions.prompt: Iverson and LeBron had big playoff nights at 25 or under. How many did 21-year-old Luka Dončić score in his 2020 OT winner vs the Clippers?
questions.context: Luka Dončić · Mavericks vs Clippers · 2020 playoffs
questions.note: With 17 rebounds and 13 assists: a playoff triple-double capped by his own game-winner.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: His winning shot capped an incredible triple-double performance with 43 points, 17 rebounds, and 13 assists.

funFacts.text: Dallas was down by one when Luka's three beat the overtime buzzer.

source.quote: Down by 1, Luka Dončić hit the game-winning 3 point buzzer-beater at the end of overtime.

funFacts.text: He was the youngest playoff game-winner on a buzzer-beater.
